_comment: Everything about hiring officers lives here and is meant to be edited.
Add names, write bios, invent skills, change what a search costs. A file
that breaks a rule is rejected at load with the reason in pemf.log, and
names   -- the pool officers are named from
bios    -- one line of flavour, picked at random
skills  -- what an officer can be good at
roles   -- the six posts, what they cost, and which skills they can have
TIERS: novice (1 skill), journeyman (2), master (3). Paying searches for
an officer of that standing -- it does NOT buy one. Finding somebody is a
roll, and a dearer search is a better roll, not a certainty.
bios: Sailed nine years under a captain he will not name, and does not care to be asked.
Lost a brother off Campeche and has been looking for the ship that did it ever since.
Was a merchant's clerk once. Says the sea is honester work, and means it.
Came ashore with a pardon in his pocket and drank the value of it in a week.
Keeps a psalter he cannot read and a knife he plainly can use.
Was pressed into a King's ship at fifteen and has had opinions about kings since.
Has buried two wives and three captains, and speaks better of the wives.
Talks little, works steadily, and has never once been found where he should not be.
Swears he has seen the Maelstrom. Nobody argues, which he takes for agreement.
Carries a Spanish coin with a hole through it and will not say what stopped it.
Learned his trade in the Mediterranean and thinks little of Caribbean weather.
Was quartermaster on a ship that voted itself to pieces, and learned from it.
Deserted a plantation and would rather hang than see one again.
Can read a sky better than most men read a chart.
Owes money in four ports and remembers exactly which four.

skills.name: A Sharp Eye
skills.text: He counts a prize's worth before the smoke clears, and little goes astray.

skills.name: A Fair Share
skills.text: The men trust his arithmetic, which is worth more than the arithmetic.

skills.name: A Hard Bargain
skills.text: He has never paid an asking price in his life.

skills.name: A Steady Hand
skills.text: Nothing aboard hurries him, and nothing aboard goes wrong twice.

skills.name: An Old Salt
skills.text: He has weathered worse, says so, and the crew believe him.

skills.name: Prize Master
skills.text: He knows which hull is worth taking and which is worth burning.

skills.name: Well Liked
skills.text: The hands work the harder for him, and none of them could tell you why.

roles.name: Quartermaster
roles.blurb: a fairer share, and a crew that knows it

roles.name: Sailing Master
roles.blurb: she handles better in a blow

roles.name: Bosun
roles.blurb: the hands work faster and grumble less

roles.name: Carpenter
roles.blurb: repairs at sea, and fewer of them needed
